Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri

INSOLVENCY ACT 1967

INSOLVENCY (COSTS) (AMENDMENT) RULES 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 123 of the Insolvency Act 1967 [Act 360],
the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (a) These rules may be cited as the Insolvency (Costs) (Amendment)
Rules 2017.

(b) These Rules come into operation on 6 October 2017.

General amendment
2. The Insolvency (Cost) Rules 1969 [ P.U. (A) 200/1969 ], which are referred to as
the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended—

(a) by substituting for th e words "Official Assignee" wherever appearing the
words "Director General of Insolvency";

(b) in English text by substituting for the word "scale" wherever appearing
the word "Schedule"; and

(c) in the national language text—

(i) by substituting for the word "belanja " wherever appearing the
word "kos";

(ii) by substituting for the word "bayaran" wherever appearing the
word "fi";
